description: A 5-district heist across Night City: meet the fixer in Watson, infiltrate an Arasaka data vault in Japantown, survive a betrayal in Heywood, breach the vault in Santo Domingo, and extract from Dogtown.

node_01_watson_guardian.title: The Meet at Lizzies
node_01_watson_guardian.description: Dexter DeShawn's fixer in Watson points you at a high-payoff Arasaka data vault in Japantown. Sweeten the deal or walk away.

node_02_japantown_puzzle.title: The Arasaka Vault
node_02_japantown_puzzle.description: Japantown's netrunner dens guard a corpo data vault. Bypass the ICE and slip the payload out past the tower's security.

node_03_heywood_setback.title: The Ambush
node_03_heywood_setback.description: A rival Valentino crew hits your convoy in Heywood — the fixer's been burned. Fight through or escape the firefight.

node_04_santo_domingo_climax.title: The Vault Breach
node_04_santo_domingo_climax.description: Santo Domingo's industrial sprawl hides the extraction point. Crack the facility's core — the hardest check of the run.

node_05_dogtown_reward.title: Extraction at the Airstrip
node_05_dogtown_reward.description: Dogtown's off-the-books airstrip. The get-away AV idles on the pad — the payload is yours. Buy in, or flatline trying.
